name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible by default. This lets keyboard users bypass repetitive navigation blocks instantly, cutting tab stops from dozens to one. The trade-off is a small visual footprint—users who rely on mouse or touch won’t need it, but it doesn’t harm their experience.

name: Reader
text: A large, always-visible skip link steals focus from the main content for sighted users, forcing them to tab past it. A skip link that only appears on focus fails sighted keyboard users who rely on visual cues to navigate. The real risk is inconsistent behavior—either way, some users lose. Settle it with a focus-trapped skip link that’s hidden until tabbed to, then auto-hides after activation.
